INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Information and Communication Technology

2. When learning Graphic Design, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Graphic Design.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Graphic Design.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Graphic Design.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Graphic Design.

3. When learning Robotics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Robotics.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Robotics.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Robotics.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Robotics.

4. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Overload every socket

5. When learning Emerging Trends in ICT, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emerging Trends in ICT.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emerging Trends in ICT.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Emerging Trends in ICT.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emerging Trends in ICT.

6. When learning Audial- Visual Creation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Audial- Visual Creation.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audial- Visual Creation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audial- Visual Creation.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audial- Visual Creation.

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

8. When learning Artificial Intelligence, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Artificial Intelligence.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Artificial Intelligence.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Artificial Intelligence.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Artificial Intelligence.

9. When learning Digital Citizenship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Citizenship.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Citizenship.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Citizenship.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Digital Citizenship.

10. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Artificial Intelligence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Robotics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Graphic Design and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Audial- Visual Creation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Information and Communication Technology

2. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Graphic Design.

3. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Robotics.

4. A — Never touch live wires with wet hands

5. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emerging Trends in ICT.

6. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audial- Visual Creation.

7. A — CPU

8. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Artificial Intelligence.

9. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Citizenship.

10. C — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

11. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Artificial Intelligence; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

12. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Robotics; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Graphic Design; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Audial- Visual Creation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
